human translation: It allows me to work by following my vibes and molding my teaching style to the learning style of the audience.
source text: ስሜቴን በመከተል እንድሰራ እና የማስተማር ስልቴን ወደ ታዳሚዎቹ የመማር ስልት እንድቀርጽ ያስችለኛል።
claude: It enables me to work by following my feelings and to shape my teaching style to the audience's learning style.
gemini: It allows me to follow my intuition and tailor my teaching style to the audience's learning style.
gemma: Following my name, I can create and transfer my learning method to my students.
llamma: It is advisable to follow the rules and regulations and to transfer the maintenance and repair of the elevator to the authorized maintenance team.
nllb: It allows me to work with my passion and adapt my teaching style to the learning style of the audience.
openai: It enables me to work by following my intuition and to tailor my teaching method to the learners’ learning styles.
qwen: Smeteen ba mktelet ensaresha na haya mastamar shalteen defada maamarin shalteen ensaq qachort uasqhalynichela.

human translation: The unrelenting soul-force of those who would hold us accountable blows that all away.
source text: ተጠያቂ አድርገው የሚይዙን የእነሱ የማያቋርጠው ውስጠ ኃይላቸው ያንን ሁሉ ያጠፋል።
claude: Their relentless inner power that holds us accountable destroys all of that.
gemini: Their unceasing inner power destroys everything that holds us accountable.
gemma: The questioner, by taking a stand, will eliminate all of their inexhaustible inner power.
llamma: He who is being criticized will be acquitted of all he says.
nllb: their unrelenting inner power that holds us accountable destroys all that.
openai: Their relentless inner strength destroys all those they hold accountable.
qwen: The main idea of this sentence is that all the given information is sufficient and enough.

human translation: When taken regularly in therapeutic doses, ginger root can effectively cure nausea;
source text: በቴራፒያዊ ልኬት በመደበኛነት ሲወሰድ የዝንጅብል ስር ማቅለሽለሽን በውጤታማነት ሊፈውስ ይችላል፤
claude: When taken regularly in therapeutic doses, ginger root can effectively cure nausea.
gemini: When taken regularly in therapeutic doses, ginger root can effectively cure nausea.
gemma: Ginger root therapy, when properly administered, can be effective.
llamma: In a theatrical performance, in the manner of a tragic play, the audience is in a state of suspense, eagerly awaiting the outcome.
nllb: When taken in therapeutic doses, ginger root can effectively treat nausea;
openai: When taken regularly at a therapeutic dose, ginger root can effectively relieve nausea.
qwen: Land reform will be carried out with great care and prudence, ensuring fair distribution of land in practice.

human translation: They accomplished their goals and created a legacy of self-determination to which others may aspire.
source text: ግቦቻቸውን በማሳካት ሌሎች ሊመኙት የሚችሉትን በራስ የመወሰንን ቅርስ ፈጥረዋል።
claude: By achieving their goals, they have created a legacy of self-determination that others can aspire to.
gemini: By achieving their goals, they have created a legacy of self-determination that others might desire.
gemma: They created a system where others can be judged by showcasing their achievements.
llamma: They took the opportunity to take revenge with their own hands.
nllb: by achieving their goals, they have created a legacy of self-determination that others may long for.
openai: By achieving their goals, they have created a legacy of self-determination that others can aspire to.
qwen: The examination was conducted thoroughly and all the candidates passed the preliminary test.

human translation: But faster economic activity could also translate into some degree of inflation.
source text: የፈጠነ ኢኮኖሚያዊ እንቅስቃሴ ግን ወደ የተወሰነ ደረጃ የዋጋ ግሽበት ሊያመራም ይችላል።
claude: Accelerated economic activity, however, may also lead to a certain degree of inflation.
gemini: However, rapid economic activity can also lead to a certain level of inflation.
gemma: A newly created economic movement can, however, lead to a certain level of price volatility.
llamma: The economic interests of the past will be able to be realized in the current market.
nllb: But rapid economic activity can also lead to some degree of inflation.
openai: Rapid economic activity, however, can also lead to a certain degree of price inflation.
qwen: Economic inequality can only be addressed up to a certain level before equal distribution becomes unrealistic.

human translation: The main characteristics a stone should possess are uniform surface, grain, and density.
source text: አንድ ድንጋይ ሊኖሩት የሚገቡት ዋና ዋና ባህሪያት ገፅታ፣ ቅንጣታዊነት እና እፍጋት ናቸው።
claude: The main characteristics that a stone should have are texture, granularity, and density.
gemini: The main characteristics a stone should have are texture, granularity, and density.
gemma: One of the main characteristics of a good container is its capacity, durability, and safety.
llamma: The main characteristics of those who gather to be in a group are pride, arrogance, and haughtiness.
nllb: The main characteristics of a stone are its shape, granularity and density.
openai: The main characteristics that a rock should have are texture, granularity, and porosity.
qwen: A single drop of blood carries the stains of violence, racism, and hate.

human translation: Lettuce, no matter the variety, is considered a cool-weather crop.
source text: ምንም አይነት ይሁን ሰላጣ የቀዝቃዛ የአየር ንብረት ሰብል እንደሆነ ይቆጠራል።
claude: Regardless of the type, lettuce is considered a cool climate crop.
gemini: Regardless of the type, lettuce is considered a cold-climate crop.
gemma: No matter what kind it is, cold air property is considered to be a blessing.
llamma: Whatever the case, it is certain that the sky is blue.
nllb: regardless of the type, lettuce is considered a cold climate crop.
openai: Any kind of lettuce is considered a cool-season crop.
qwen: What would you do if this were the first time we met at an airport?

human translation: It was a trick to lure foolish humans to an ogre who would teach them a very valuable lesson.
source text: ሞኝ ሰዎችን በጣም ዋጋ ያለው ትምህርት ወደሚያስተምራቸው አንድ ጭራቅ የሚስብ ተንኮል ነበር።
claude: It was a trick that lured foolish people to a monster that would teach them a very valuable lesson.
gemini: It was a trick that lured foolish people to a monster that would teach them a very valuable lesson.
gemma: A very valuable education was being given to the people who were most in need, like a precious gift.
llamma: The people who were in great need of education were receiving education in a very small tent.
nllb: it was a ruse to lure the foolish to a monster who taught them a valuable lesson.
openai: It was a sly, enticing trick that would teach fools a very valuable lesson.
qwen: The argument between the spouses is still raging and has not cooled down at all.

human translation: Just to clarify, though, assertive is not the same as aggressive or arrogant.
source text: ግልፅ ለማድረግ ያህል፣ አስረግጦ የሚገለፅ ከተተናኳይ ወይም ከትዕቢተኛ ጋር ተመሳሳይ አይደለም።
claude: To clarify, being assertive is not the same as being aggressive or arrogant.
gemini: To be clear, being assertive is not the same as being aggressive or arrogant.
gemma: In order to make it clear, it is not like something that is revealed after being asked or from an authoritative source.
llamma: A person who is to be pitied is not one who is sick or poor, but one who is helpless.
nllb: to be clear, a boastful person is not the same as a boastful or haughty one.
openai: To be clear, being assertive is not the same as being aggressive or arrogant.
qwen: The meeting for discussion has just begun, lets hope it proceeds smoothly.

human translation: The bus, normally crowded, was stunningly nearly empty at this hour.
source text: በተለምዶ የሚጨናነቀው አውቶቢስ በዚህ ሰዓት ባዶ ሊሆን ምንም ያልቀረው መሆኑ አስደናቂ ነበር።
claude: The fact that the usually crowded bus was almost certainly empty at this hour was surprising.
gemini: It was surprising that the usually crowded bus was almost empty at this time.
gemma: The bus that was supposed to be crowded at this hour was surprisingly empty.
llamma: Its not worth the effort to be an atheist at this time to be a hypocrite, to do whatever one pleases.
nllb: amazingly, the normally crowded bus was almost empty at this hour.
openai: It was surprising that the bus, which is usually crowded, was completely empty at this hour.
qwen: A newly purchased automobile was stolen this morning and has not yet been recovered.

human translation: She can do things with her tongue most of us can't even fathom, like touch her elbow or lick her own ear.
source text: አብዛኛዎቻችን ለመረዳት እንኳን የማንችላቸውን ክርኗን እንደመንካት ወይም ጆሮዋን እንደመላስ አይነት ነገሮች በምላሷ ማድረግ ትችላለች።
claude: She can do things with her tongue like touching her elbow or licking her ear that most of us can't even comprehend.
gemini: She can do things with her tongue that most of us can't even comprehend, like touching her elbow or licking her ear.
gemma: Most of them cant understand what they are saying, so she can do things like cover their mouths or plug their ears.
llamma: Our attention to your requests will be to your satisfaction, whether it is a small matter or a major one, she will take care of it.
nllb: she can do things with her tongue that most of us can't even understand, like touch her cheek or move her ear.
openai: Most of us don’t even realize the kinds of things she can do with her tongue, such as touching her nose or her ear.
qwen: Here are the translations of the given Amharic text into English: The cases that should be submitted for consideration are either the most important ones or the most urgent ones that are currently being discussed.

human translation: He ran a dairy herd, kept sheep, and grew potatoes, cereals, and wheat-straw for thatching.
source text: የወተት ከብቶች መንጋ አስተዳድሯል፣ በጎች አርብቷል፣ ድንች፣ ጥራጥሬዎች እና ለሳር ጣሪያ የስንዴ ገለባ አሳድጓል።
claude: He managed a herd of dairy cattle, raised sheep, and grew potatoes, legumes, and wheat straw for thatched roofing.
gemini: He managed a herd of dairy cattle, raised sheep, and grew potatoes, grains, and wheat straw for thatching.
gemma: The milk has been collected from the herds, the roads have been cleared, the ditches have been dug, the trees have been trimmed, and the shelter for the animals has been prepared.
llamma: The cattle are being fed with hay, fed with grass, given oats, barley, and wheat for the sheep.
nllb: He managed a herd of dairy cattle, raised sheep, and raised potatoes, cereals, and wheat straw for the hay roof.
openai: She has managed a herd of dairy cattle, raised sheep, and grown potatoes, vegetables, and wheat straw for thatching.
qwen: The weather is cloudy, it rains, thunder, lightning and heavy showers cause strong winds.

human translation: Each step unleashed a waft of that divine scent, filling my lungs with pure bliss.
source text: እያንዳንዱ እርምጃ የዛን የተቀደሰ መዓዛ ሽውታ ሲለቀው ሳንባዎቼን በንፁህ ሃሴት ሞላቸው።
claude: Each step released that sacred fragrance, filling my lungs with pure joy.
gemini: Each step released a waft of that sacred aroma, filling my lungs with pure delight.
gemma: Each action, as a reward for the past, was filling my pockets with pure wealth.
llamma: Everywhere the winds blow, the leaves of the trees fall, and scatter your memories in the vastness of the sky.
nllb: every step released the fragrance of that sacred perfume filled my lungs with pure joy.
openai: Every step released a waft of that sacred fragrance, filling my lungs with pure joy.
qwen: One illness has reached the capital and spread across the country within three weeks.

human translation: Lower population means a lower chance of having an accident in addition to fewer liability claims.
source text: ዝቅተኛ የህዝብ ብዛት ማለት ለአደጋ የመጋለጥ እድል ዝቅተኛ መሆን በተጨማሪም የተጠያቂነት ይገባኛል ጥያቄዎች አነስተኛ መሆን ማለት ነው።
claude: Low population density means lower exposure to risk and fewer liability claims.
gemini: A low population means a lower risk of exposure to danger, as well as fewer liability claims.
gemma: A small population of people means a small chance of being exposed to danger, and it also means that the questions asked are minor.
llamma: A relatively large population growth is considered to be a positive factor for a countrys development, in addition to being a factor of resilience. Asking questions that are too complex is considered to be a sign of being relatively intelligent.
nllb: A small population means a lower risk of exposure and also a lower risk of liability claims.
openai: A low population means a lower chance of exposure to danger and, in addition, fewer accountability questions.
qwen: How appropriate are the current economic conditions for a fair and inclusive election?

human translation: We’ll be glad to provide expert advice to assist you with how much you can comfortably afford to borrow.
source text: በምቹ ሁኔታ ለመበደር ስለሚችሉት መጠን እርስዎን ለማገዝ የባለሙያ ምክር ለመስጠት ደስተኞች ነን።
claude: We are happy to provide expert advice to help you regarding the amount you can borrow comfortably.
gemini: We are happy to offer expert advice to help you with the amount you can comfortably borrow.
gemma: We are delighted to provide expert advice to help you achieve the best possible outcome.
llamma: In times of great anxiety, I am here to console you.
nllb: we are happy to provide professional advice to help you as you can borrow on favorable terms.
openai: We are happy to offer professional advice to help you determine how much you can comfortably invest.
qwen: In this case study for training purposes so far two mentors for guidance of these young mothers are needed.

human translation: The works span the gamut from medicine to astronomy, from Quranic exegesis to philosophy and poetry.
source text: የስራዎቹ ወሰን ከህክምና እስከ ስነ ፈለክ፣ ከቁርዓን እንድምታ እስከ ፍልስፍና እና ስነ ግጥም ያዳርሳል።
claude: The scope of the works ranges from medicine to astronomy, from Quranic interpretation to philosophy and poetry.
gemini: The scope of his works ranges from medicine to astronomy, and from Quranic commentary to philosophy and poetry.
gemma: The works span from medicine to fine arts, from the Quran to philosophy and poetry.
llamma: Their work ranges from chemistry to physics, from cryptography to philosophy and mathematics.
nllb: The scope of his works ranges from medicine to astronomy, from Quranic inference to philosophy and poetry.
openai: The scope of his works extends from medicine to astronomy, from Qur'anic exegesis to philosophy and poetry.
qwen: The duration of pregnancy ranges from nine months to ten months, from childbirth to menopause and the onset of mensturation.

human translation: Adaptability - flexible, agile mindset, optimistic approach;
source text: ተላምዶአዊነት - ተለዋዋጭ፣ ቀልጣፋ አስተሳሰብ፣ ብሩህ አመለካከት፤
claude: Adaptability - flexible, agile thinking, positive outlook;
gemini: Adaptability: flexible, agile thinking, an optimistic outlook.
gemma: Creativity - Diverse, imaginative thinking, brilliant insight;
llamma: Feminism - A Rebellious, Radical, and Ruthless Struggle
nllb: Audacity - flexible, agile thinking, optimistic and optimistic
openai: Conventionality - flexible, quick thinking, bright outlook;
qwen: Awareness - education, training, and empowerment.

human translation: Being grateful is showing appreciation with kindness, whereas being thankful is simply being pleased and relieved.
source text: ውለታ አክባሪ መሆን ማለት አድናቆትን ከቸርነት ጋር ማሳየት ሲሆን አመስጋኝ መሆን ማለት ደግሞ በቀላሉ ደስታን እና እፎይታን ማግኘት ነው።
claude: Being grateful means showing appreciation with kindness, while being thankful means simply finding joy and relief.
gemini: Being appreciative of a favor is to show appreciation with kindness, while being grateful is to easily find joy and relief.
gemma: Happiness is about showing gratitude with kindness and contentment, while joy is about easily finding happiness and fulfillment.
llamma: Being an extremist means to justify violence along with terrorism, while being an extremist in the sense of being a radical means to accept things immediately and get excited.
nllb: to be appreciative is to show appreciation with kindness, and to be grateful is to find joy and relief easily.
openai: Being courteous means showing admiration with kindness, and being grateful means easily finding joy and relief.
qwen: A medical degree is a prerequisite for a medical profession and also involves practical training.

human translation: Add these ingredients: oil, white wine vinegar, salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
source text: እነኚህን ንጥረ ነገሮች ይጨምሩ፡ ዘይት፣ የነጭ ወይን ኮምጣጤ፣ ጨው እና አዲስ የተፈጨ ቁንዶ በርበሬ።
claude: Add these ingredients: oil, white wine vinegar, salt and freshly ground black pepper.
gemini: Add these ingredients: oil, white wine vinegar, salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
gemma: These ingredients are added: oil, white wine vinegar, pepper, and fresh coriander.
llamma: These are the vegetables to be chopped: onions, garlic, ginger, and chopped fresh cilantro.
nllb: Add these ingredients: oil, white wine vinegar, salt and freshly ground chili pepper.
openai: Add these ingredients: oil, white wine vinegar, salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
qwen: Consider these nations to be young and fragile and unstable. They are like a child and a weak person who needs protection.

human translation: Make the best of it before we depart for the airport in the early afternoon and bid farewell to Mauritius.
source text: ከሰዓት በኋላ በጊዜ ወደ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ከመነሳታችን እና ሞሪሽየስን ከመሰናበታችን በፊት አጋጣሚውን በሚገባ ተጠቀሙበት።
claude: Make good use of the opportunity before we leave for the airport on time in the afternoon and bid farewell to Mauritius.
gemini: They made the most of the opportunity in the afternoon before our timely departure to the airport and our farewell to Mauritius.
gemma: One hour later, take the opportunity to go to the airport and before we leave for Mauritius.
llamma: After sunset, before the evening, we went to the Aurora viewing place and took photos in front of the beautiful scenery.
nllb: We took advantage of the opportunity before we left for the airport in the afternoon and said goodbye to Mauritius.
openai: Make proper use of the opportunity within the hour, from our departure for the airport until before we land in Mauritius.
qwen: For now, in light of the current situation in Europe towards African and Moroccan borders this morning, negotiations have been postponed.

human translation: With amazing enthusiasm they are at work, and wherever I pass they wave and greet with a loud call.
source text: በሚደንቅ የጋለ ስሜት ስራ ላይ ናቸው፣ እናም ባለፍኩ ቁጥር እያውለበለቡ በታላቅ ድምፅ ሰላምታ ይሰጣሉ።
claude: They are at work with remarkable enthusiasm, and every time I pass by, they wave and greet me with loud voices.
gemini: They are at work with a wonderful enthusiasm, and they wave and greet me loudly every time I pass.
gemma: They are working on a delicate and sensitive matter, and when they learn the number of those affected, they will announce peace with a loud voice.
llamma: They are doing a good job in the field of agriculture, and they are increasing the population in a peaceful manner.
nllb: They are engaged in a wonderful feast of enthusiasm, and they salute each passing person with a loud cheer.
openai: They are at work with an astonishing sense of togetherness, and as I pass by, they greet me in a loud voice while chanting numbers.
qwen: There is a lot of space between the lines, and the phone number will be aligned neatly with the centered salutation.

human translation: He is a symbol of a passionate but very frustrated, even misguided, leader.
source text: እሱ ስሜታዊ ነገር ግን በጣም ብስጩ እንደውም የተሳሳተ መሪ ምልክት ነው።
claude: He is emotional but very immature and indeed a misguided leader.
gemini: He is emotional but very irritable, which is in fact a sign of a flawed leader.
gemma: He is a sentimental person but a very strong and decisive leader.
llamma: He is a person with a good character, but in his behavior, he is a person who is easily irritated.
nllb: he is emotional but very frustrated and a sign of a wrong leader.
openai: He is emotional, but very timid, which is also a sign of a misguided leader.
qwen: The human species is unique in its ability to truly care for its own kind.

human translation: The book's title was "Time to Assess Invalid Ideas."
